## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the §6.4 **rights, losses, quotas and recipient
   handoff validation** rows — per-item rights/access/expiry/loss
   records (`source/version, license/consent evidence,
   recipients/uses, owner/decision, expiry`; unknown rights =
   withheld; no secret-bearing bundle; held-out
   solutions/oracle/model I/O default restricted; public numerical
   rows and sensitive/low-entropy identifiers inspected too),
   bounded local handoff under the §6.4 scope/ceiling table (public
   review ≤512 MiB/asset · ≤2 GiB compressed/8 GiB expanded · ≤10
   GiB first wave; controlled review ≤20 GiB/12 months; read-only
   grant ≤30 days · object/version links ≤1 h · no write/delete/
   list; recipient prebuilt ≤2 GiB download/8 GiB expansion · $0),
   sanitized replacement → new identity + supersession + dependent
   claims recalculated + exact per-procedure loss (changed bytes
   never retain native hashes/R1), expiry/GC/deletion → permitted
   superseding status/tombstones + dependent procedures disabled,
   shorter rights override retention honestly, full-archive/
   versions/backups/cost/retention metadata carrying actual dates
   before commitments — inside `hh-bundle` (the recipient-procedure
   owner beside `closure.rs`/`cards.rs`; I-02 one home;
   records-in/records-out, no public RPC — C.4).
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.27.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.21
   `evidence-package/1` + `access` member group, R5.22
   `closure_walk`/`closure_report` + fetch/trust arms, R5.23
   `assemble_receipt`/`population-receipt/1`, R5.24 decode bounds
   (`MemberEscape`/`MemberExpansion`) + R0 fold, R5.25
   `recompute_analysis`, R5.26 `admit_replay`/`admit_fresh` cards.
   A new shared/persisted decision lands in the owning ADR
   admission (landing-record ADR, ADR-0024 rung).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): per-item rights/access/expiry/loss
  validation and bounded local handoff; sanitized replacement
  creates new identity + supersession with dependent claims
  recalculated; full archive/versions/backups/cost/retention
  metadata carries actual dates before commitments.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): unknown rights, secret material,
  sensitive low-entropy identifiers, unauthorized/expired fetch,
  quota/expansion breach and deletion-marker-only evidence refuse;
  controlled closure is not public closure; optional
  S3/account/provisioning requires separate authority.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership and evidence): the three primary targets
  resolved to numbered checks + actual evidence in the coverage
  register; achieved D/E recorded separately from owed R/P or
  actual-execution E; R5.52 contributor evidence remains owed
  (evidence dependency, never dispatch dependency).
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression;
  fmt + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode per touch;
  scratch stores; exact commands + counts.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green in scope; REQ ids
  stamped; DEFERRALS rows for owed legs; ADRs for owned decisions;
  run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; operating clauses.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-bundle/src/rights.rs` (new, target ≤420 lines) — the
   §6.4 rights/losses/quotas/handoff owner interfaces,
   records-in/records-out beside `closure.rs`/`cards.rs`
   (I-02 one home; no public RPC — C.4):
   - record kinds `rights-record/1` (per-item binding input),
     `handoff-report/1` (idp-sealed verdict), `rights-supersession/1`
     (sanitized replacement), `rights-tombstone/1` (departure status);
     closed `code` set on `BundleError::RightsRefused`.
   - `HandoffScope` closed sum: `public_review` (512 MiB asset /
     2 GiB compressed / 8 GiB expanded / 10 GiB first wave),
     `controlled_review` (≤20 GiB originals), `access_grant`
     (read-only ≤30 days · links ≤1 h · no write/delete/list),
     `full_archive` (≤200 GiB declared envelope — "stop/requote on
     breach"), `recipient_procedure` (≤2 GiB download / 8 GiB
     expansion · $0), `optional_hosting` → `separate_authority`
     refusal (S3/account/provisioning needs its own operator
     decision — never a silent admit).
   - `admit_handoff(&Decoded, &HandoffPlan, now_ms) ->
     Result<HandoffReport, BundleError>` legs: `metadata`
     (contact/region + quoted/decided/review_before actual dates —
     missing → `missing_date`, future → `future_date`; host naming
     S3/account scheme → `separate_authority`) → `grant`
     (access scope: grant ≤30 days, link ≤1 h, write/delete/list →
     `grant_overreach`) → `rights` per item (member unknown /
     absent record / decision `unknown` → withheld `unknown_rights`;
     `withheld` decision → withheld; `restricted` in public_review
     → `scope_mismatch`; restricted in controlled/access requires
     named recipient → `unauthorized_recipient`; record expiry ≤now
     → withheld `expired`; held-out roles `solution|oracle|model_io`
     with no license/consent evidence → withheld — default
     restricted) → `content` per released item (present bytes:
     `hharness_secrets::detect` secret scan → `secret_material`;
     plan `restricted_identifiers` byte scan →
     `sensitive_identifier`) → `fetch` (Fetch members: absent
     FetchEntry or remote leg `trust::admit` refusal —
     `location_expired` → `fetch_expired`, other arms →
     `unauthorized_fetch`; pool/local locations resolve locally)
     → `status` (redacted/gc items → withheld) → `departures`
     (expired/deleted/gc need actual date ≤now + evidence — a
     bare marker → `marker_not_deletion`; each emits a
     `rights-tombstone/1` + `disabled_procedures[]` via a
     role→procedure map, `verify` always) → `quotas`
     (asset/compressed/expanded/first-wave ceilings →
     `quota_breach`). Verdict `admitted|withheld|refused`;
     retention Json records `effective_until` = min(item
     expiries, declared) — shorter rights win.
   - `sanitize_replace(&Decoded, member, new_bytes,
     &SanitizeTransform) -> Result<SanitizedItem, BundleError>`:
     identical bytes → `unchanged_bytes`; `mapping_permitted:false`
     → `unpermitted_mapping`; secret/sensitive scans on new bytes;
     replacement = `hharness_identity::address(new_bytes, media)` —
     a NEW identity (changed bytes never retain native hashes/R1);
     dependent claims recalculated by walking the manifest document
     for references to the original address (`{field, from, to}`
     rows); per-procedure losses `{procedure, loss:
     "native_identity", r_levels: "R0"}`; sealed
     `rights-supersession/1`.
2. `crates/hh-bundle/src/error.rs` —
   `BundleError::RightsRefused{code, detail}` (+≈12).
3. `crates/hh-bundle/src/lib.rs` — module + exports (+≈8).
4. `crates/hh-bundle/tests/r5_27.rs` (target ≤300 lines) —
